style: Main title theme of a retro-cinematic pixel-art starship game about a lone relay tender flying the dark outside of a ring of relays above the clouds. A soft ticking pulse like a blinking lamp and a felt piano state a melancholic, hopeful minor-key theme over warm analog synth pads; warm analog synthesizer arpeggios and a gentle sequenced bass join, then the theme returns on a clean electric guitar and a singing synth lead with cello, strings and glass bells, rising to a wide, heroic, bittersweet statement, and settles back to the piano and the lamp pulse. Spacious reverb, melodic and cinematic. Purely instrumental. Dm, 96 BPM.
